Term1: NEUT FEVER CAND NOT ORAL THERA
Text:
## NEUTROPENIC FEVER--PATIENT IS NOT A CANDIDATE FOR ORAL THERAPY
## Inpatient/ER Vancomycin is not recommended as a standard part of the initial antibiotic
regimen. Consider adding Vancomycin for specific clinical indications:
>> Suspected catheter-related infection,
>> Skin or soft-tissue infection,
>> Pneumonia,
>> Hemodynamic instability
## Treatment
Empirical intravenous regimens WITHOUT vancomycin
Empirical intravenous regimens WITH vancomycin
## Outpatient

Refer to Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS. References
Hughes WT Clin Infect Dis 2002, 34: 730
Rolston KVI Clin Infect Dis 2004, 39: S44
Sipsas NV Cancer 2005, 103: 1103
